vehicle_recognition.exterior_model_badge_note: The model name does not appear on the exterior of the vehicle.
vehicle_recognition.tri_motor_identifier_note: A Cerberus head emblem on the right rear of Cybertruck indicates a tri-motor performance vehicle.

silent_vehicle_warning.source_text: LACK OF ENGINE NOISE DOES NOT MEAN VEHICLE IS OFF: SILENT MOVEMENT OR INSTANT RESTART CAPABILITY EXISTS UNTIL VEHICLE IS FULLY SHUT DOWN. WEAR APPROPRIATE PPE.

stabilization_points.meaning: Safe stabilization points for Cybertruck resting on its side
stabilization_points.source_text: yellow Safe stabilization points for Cybertruck resting on its side

ordered_steps.source_text: Double cut the first responder loop.
Double cut negative cable to the 48V battery only if necessary.

first_responder_loop.source_text: Always double cut the first responder loop.

high_voltage_isolation.warning: Not every high voltage component is labeled.
high_voltage_isolation.source_text: Not every high voltage component is labeled. Always wear appropriate PPE. Always double cut the first responder loop. Do not attempt to open the high voltage (HV) battery.

warnings.source_text: Electrical and mechanical releases like doors and seat belts may be compromised after a collision.
The seats, steering wheel, and interior door buttons are electrically powered and may not function after a collision.
After a collision, the doors may not unlock from the outside. Extrication may be required.
The body is constructed of stainless steel exterior panels with ultra-high strength steel inner structure.
The windshield, roof, and moving door glass are made of laminated glass.

access_methods.source_text: OPENING DOORS FROM OUTSIDE WITH POWER
OPENING DOORS FROM INSIDE WITH POWER
OPENING TONNEAU AND LIFTGATE WITH POWER
Touch the open hood button on the touchscreen
OPENING FRONT DOORS FROM INSIDE WITHOUT POWER
OPENING REAR DOORS FROM INSIDE WITHOUT POWER

access_methods.notes: Icons indicate power seats / related powered controls

access_methods.source_text: Use external power supply to OPEN

glass.source_text: Windshield, roof, and moving door glass are laminated glass. The rear window and front quarter side windows are tempered glass.

high_strength_zones.source_text: External body panels made of stainless steel.
Understructure for the A, B, and C pillar are made of ultra-high strength steel.
Forward overhead rail is made of high strength steel.

high_voltage_cables.source_text: All high voltage cables have ORANGE INSULATION.

prohibited_actions.source_text: Never cut or open high voltage components or cables.

prohibitions.source_text: DO NOT SUBMERGE VEHICLE TO EXTINGUISH/COOL BATTERY FIRE

suppression_cooling_actions.source_text: USE LARGE AMOUNTS OF WATER TO COOL THE BATTERY ENCLOSURE FROM THE BOTTOM OF THE VEHICLE

monitoring_requirements.source_text: MONITOR HV BATTERY TEMPERATURE FOR AT LEAST 24 HOURS

ordered_steps.source_text: Wear appropriate PPE for water rescue.
Remove the vehicle from the water
continue with normal high voltage disabling
Raise the front of the vehicle approximately 30 cm (1 foot) to allow water to drain out of the vehicle and battery pack

guidance: Treat a submerged Cybertruck like any other submerged vehicle.

drainage_lift_requirement.purpose: allow water to drain out of vehicle and battery pack
drainage_lift_requirement.source_text: Raise the front of the vehicle approximately 30 cm (1 foot) to allow water to drain out of the vehicle and battery pack

submersion.hazard_note: Vehicles submerged in water should be handled with a greater potential risk of an HV battery fire.

transport_method.source_text: Use a towing truck with flatbed.

prohibited_methods.source_text: NO towing with running traction wheels.

pre_transport_checks.source_text: HV BATTERY TEMPERATURE SHOULD BE CHECKED BEFORE TRANSPORT

post_incident_storage.source_text: POSSIBLE BATTERY RE-IGNITION! AFTER A FIRE INCIDENT, STORE OUTSIDE AT A SAFE DISTANCE (AT LEAST 50 FT/ 15 M) FROM OTHER VEHICLES AND STRUCTURES!

validation_policy.rule: A value is populated only where it is explicitly written, diagrammatically represented, or clearly identified in the supplied rescue-sheet pages.
validation_policy.diagram_policy: Do not convert a pictogram into a more precise physical location unless the supplied diagram directly supports that location.
validation_policy.unsupported_detail_policy: Use a non-specific location descriptor or omit the detail rather than infer an exact component placement.
